---
title: "Entorno local"
---

## 1. Clonar el repo

```bash
git clone <url-del-repo>
cd <repo>
```

<!-- ## 2. Variables de entorno

## 2. Levantar servicios

```bash
docker compose up -d
```

| Servicio | URL local |
|---|---|
| Frontend | http://localhost:3000 |
| Backend / API | http://localhost:8000 |
| Base de datos | localhost: |
